reviews.comment: Absolutely phenomenal professor of practice who clearly knows his field. Since the class content didn't interest me much, the 2.5-hour weekly lecture was hard to get through. Homework assignments are long and open-ended, but the grading is fair.

If there is one class that has helped me immensely in my career, and a lecturer who I was truly inspired by his teaching style, it would be Dr Graul. I am writing this review 4 years after graduating, while preparing for a dream job interview, while going through his notes on Lean Engineering.

Dr Graul, if you read this, THANK YOU!

Lectures are long and and a TON of information. They are recorded to review after. Not many assignments, but the assignments are long and difficult. Homework and quiz grading was strict. Everything is open note but time restrained. Group project at the end of the semester, our report was around 40 pages.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is knowledgeable person, but TBH cant teach. Hes mostly focused on covering multiple topics instead of actually giving some specific knowledge. Also says this is the last homework/assignment but keeps on giving HW's which are BTW too heavy. Unfortunately there no other lecturer for this awesome course to teach, which is the only downside of tamu
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Teaches 150+ slides per week. Total slides for this course comes out to be 1800-1900. We can complete full masters if we read those many pages. Just reads the slides in class. No value addition. Basically we pay for this course to learn by ourselves. Assignments are very heavy. Need almost 2 days to complete 1 assignment. No time for other activiti
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Gives tons of HW. Grader gives poor grades instead of high efforts. Need to attend other lecture to complete assignments.

One of the best professors to have ever come across. Dr Graul takes an extra effort to make students understand the concepts and gives excellent feedback. The material is beneficial. His lecture notes and material can be applied in the industry. Would highly recommend taking his class.

This class is awful. Let me explain, his lecture slides are from 20-120 slides per lecture. So  CTRL + F everything. Plus his homeworks are just complicated for no reason. The lectures don't help much. We use a software which creates IDEF0 models for activities in system and to say its really bad is an understatement.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is my review of Dr Graul after 1.5 years in the industry doing Industrial Engineering work. When I have a doubt, I still refer to his notes. 90% of my work is from what he taught in the one class that I feel lucky that I took!

A legendary prof. He has too much experience in the field he is teaching about, makes you work hard for every mark given, homework is given regularly and is difficult so we get the concept better. The personalised feeling of homework where we have to design our own system and do homework on that gives it a better feel. Too Awesome!!!

He is probably the best professor I have had here. His lectures are absolute garbage and do not make any sense w 100+ slides. You will have to self learn. But Dr. Gaul is the redeeming aspect of this class, he genuinely cares about the material and wants everyone to understand(rip) and pass. He tells you what type of q's will be on the test. A Gem!

Graul is easily is the best prof I have had here, its just unfortunate the class he has to teach is extremely tedious. There is a lot of homework and group assignments. If you actually do the homework you will do well on the exams. Also helps he pretty much tells you whats on it. Learned a lot overall. Graul is also the head of undergraduate ISEN

Dr. Graul is a SUPER nice, charismatic, passionate professor but doesn't realize how much work he assigns weekly (aka 2-4 hw assignments/week). Lecture slides are very disorganized (100 SLIDES EACH). Tests cover too much material & are extremely difficult. (BE READY!) Don't get me wrong, love him, cares about students & material!<3 Hard class tho.

Absolutley one of the worst classes I have ever been in. The way the class is structured makes it super disorganized. If you dont understand something in the HW's or lab projects, you spend hours just looking for definitons or examples in the lecture slides bc there is so many pointless slides that make it hard to find what you're looking for.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: The classes can be a nightmare in the first week when you are getting used to his teaching style. After that, it's real good. I learnt a LOT in his classes. He will make you work hard and ensure you learn stuff but very generous with grades. Very approachable and jovial. Would take another class in a heartbeat.

Dr. Graul is caring and very helpful outside of class. His lectures consist of 100+ slides, but he tries to point out the most important parts and the stuff that will be on exam. His exam reviews are LONG but he makes the questions pretty similar so make sure to complete them. Textbook was helpful. Attendance is not mandatory.

He is a great prof! The class was very interesting and he wanted you to really understand the material. Instead of curving he retested material. Lecture notes seemed overwhelming because there was a lot of information on the slides, but listen to main topics he emphasizes. He provides reviews and help sessions! Overall, good class!

This is probably one of the nicest professor in the ISEN department. He makes sure you learn the material. Rather than curving an exam that has a bad average, he has a retest. Really accessible outside of class and very helpful when asked the correct questions. Will definitely be looking for his sections for future ISEN classes.

THIS CLASS SUCKS. His lecture slides for each class are usually about 100 slides and he skims them and expects you to go through all of them after class not including how unclear and the quantity of his homework. His lectures are very boring. His required exam review is 88 short response questions.
